summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature in the repository, without running tests or committing. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and widens ControlCode to admit (ControlType, str). rich/control.py adds the format entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and the Control.title classmethod. rich/console.py adds set_window_title, gated only on is_terminal, returning True when written and False otherwise, with a Google-style docstring. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch that calls term.set_title(title) from the two-item form. CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200. Tests added: test_control_title in tests/test_control.py, test_set_window_title in tests/test_console.py (assertion skipped on legacy Windows), and test_control_set_window_title in tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows-only). Verification was by reading only; no tests were run.
